title: The name and quantity required to remove the exhibition tag
goal: Use object destructuring to rename properties and provide default values ​​for missing properties.
summary: Upstream records use name and count; label output uses title and quantity. If count is missing, display as 1 item.
tasks: complete tagFields(record). Deconstruct out name and count and use local names title and quantity.
returns { title, quantity }. 1 when count is missing; retains the original value when explicitly written as 0 or null.

example.code:
const { code: label = 'Unnumbered' } = { code: 'M3' };
// label is 'M3'
example.note: The colon is followed by the local variable name, and the right side of the equal sign is the default value when the attribute value is undefined.

hint: writes const { name: title, count: quantity = 1 } = record.
